Unlife means that which is against life. Unlife can sometimes include life serving unlife. The [[Anti-Alo]] is the head of unlife.

The term is a reference to the Persian term [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Aneran aniran] meaning those against Iran and [[Zoroastrianism]]
